description:
At Leidos, we deliver innovative solutions through the efforts of our diverse and talented people who are dedicated to our customers’ success. We empower our teams, contribute to our communities, and operate sustainably. Everything we do is built on a commitment to do the right thing for our customers, our people, and our community. Our Mission, Vision, and Values guide the way we do business.
  

 Your greatest work is ahead! 

 Leidos’ Defense Systems, Advanced Sensors and Protective Technologies Portfolio is seeking a talented Software Engineer to join a multidisciplinary team to create unique solutions to complex engineering challenges in our Huntsville, AL location. This role supports the development of an in-house, containerized web application that uses computer vision, optical character recognition (OCR), and a component database to automate the analysis of electronic hardware.
  
 The Advanced Sensors and Protective Technologies Portfolio develops and evaluates sensor systems and protective capabilities that enhance threat detection, survivability, and mission effectiveness. This includes safeguarding mission-critical systems through advanced microelectronic hardware assurance to ensure components remain trusted and secure. We advance these capabilities through software and tool development, real-world testing, and performance analysis to support the transition of emerging capabilities into operational systems.
 
 If this sounds like the kind of environment where you can thrive, keep reading! 

 Leidos Defense Systems Sector provides a diverse portfolio of systems, solutions, and services covering land, sea, air, space, and cyberspace for customers worldwide. Solutions for Defense include enterprise and mission IT, large-scale intelligence systems, command and control, geospatial and data analytics, cybersecurity, logistics, training, and intelligence analysis and operations support. Our team is solving the world’s toughest security challenges for customers with “can’t fail” missions. To explore and learn more, click here !

   Are you ready to make an impact? Share your resume with us today! 

   Primary Responsibilities: 

 Design, develop, test, and maintain features across the full stack of an in-house, containerized web application, from the browser-based user interface through back-end services and data storage. 
 Build and enhance front-end interfaces using React and TypeScript, including interactive image viewers, data tables, and user review workflows. 
 Develop and maintain back-end REST APIs and processing services in Python (e.g., FastAPI), with clear API documentation (OpenAPI). 
 Integrate and improve optical character recognition (OCR), image processing, and machine learning components within the application’s processing pipeline. 
 Design and maintain PostgreSQL database schemas, queries, and migrations, and manage image and file storage using S3-compatible object storage (MinIO). 
 Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, versioning, and release management. 
 Support security hardening activities, including user authentication, STIG-aligned configuration, and remediation of vulnerability scan findings. 
 Collaborate with software engineers, product owners, end users, and security teams to translate feedback into requirements and align capabilities with product and compliance requirements. 
 Prepare technical documentation and present progress to the team and program leadership. 
 
 Basic Qualifications: 
 Bachelor’s degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related field and 2–4 years of relevant experience, or Master’s degree with less than 2 years of relevant experience. 
 Experience developing back-end services and REST APIs in Python (e.g., FastAPI, Flask, or Django). 
 Experience with front-end web development using JavaScript/TypeScript and a modern framework such as React. 
 Experience working with relational databases, including SQL and PostgreSQL. 
 Working knowledge of Docker and containerized application development, including multi-container applications with Docker Compose. 
 Familiarity with S3-compatible object storage (e.g., MinIO or Amazon S3). 
 Familiarity with OCR and image-processing libraries (e.g., EasyOCR, Tesseract, OpenCV). 
 Familiarity with version control (Git), JIRA, Agile workflows, and software engineering fundamentals. 
 Ability to troubleshoot and debug issues across the full stack and clearly communicate findings. 
 Candidate must be a resident of the North Alabama area or willing to relocate to the Huntsville - North Alabama, AL area 
 Active SECRET clearance or above. (U.S. Citizenship is required) 
 
 Preferred Qualifications: 

 Experience with React UI component libraries (e.g., Material UI) and building data-rich interfaces such as data grids, image viewers, or annotation tools. 
 Experience integrating machine learning models (e.g., PyTorch-based object detection) into production software. 
 Experience deploying containerized applications to disconnected or air-gapped environments. 
 Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated testing frameworks (e.g., pytest, Jest, Vitest). 
 Familiarity with DoD security requirements such as STIGs, vulnerability scanning, and user authentication/access control. 
 Experience integrating third-party REST APIs and building data ingestion pipelines for large datasets. 
 If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.
 
 
 Original Posting: 
November 16, 2026 
 For U.S. Positions: While subject to change based on business needs, Leidos reasonably anticipates that this job requisition will remain open for at least 3 days with an anticipated close date of no earlier than 3 days after the original posting date as listed above.







 
 
 Pay Range: 
Pay Range $69,550.00 - $125,725.00 
 The Leidos pay range for this job level is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, applicable bargaining agreement (if any), or other law.
